name: Dillon's Dead-Heat Breakers™
description:
Race down enemy grocks and rock them in battle to defend frontier villages. Action meets tower defence in Dillon’s Dead-Heat Breakers!

This time, The Red Flash himself, Dillon, will team up with your own animalised Mii character. Be strategic and use your whole team! You’ll need their help to face each wave of transforming monsters.
disclaimer:
Use Parental Controls to restrict 3D mode for children 6 and under.

You may need to upgrade your current SD Card to a compatible SDHC Card or microSDHC Card with enough available space to download this software.
Visit support.nintendo.com for information about storage options. Sold separately.
